thread:
sophia: Heads-up — we need to finalize the private deployment roadmap (VPC/on-prem packaging + upgrade paths + customer-managed networking). Can we align on MVP scope and launch criteria today? :thinking:

ian: Quick context — infra has a working helm chart and a prototype airgap tarball. But upgrades and schema migrations are still manual.

maya: From CS — top customer asks: (1) strict egress controls, (2) offline install for air-gapped sites, (3) clear upgrade path with a rollback plan. They want SLA language too.

alex: For runtime: we need KV cache compatibility guarantees across minor upgrades, otherwise customers hit cold-cache regressions. That affects rollout strategy.

jules: Security check — must support customer-managed KMS + audit log export. Also need a documented hardening guide for on-prem installs.

ian: Proposal for MVP (minimal ship):
- deliverable: helm chart + airgap installer (.tar.gz)
- network: VPC peering + CIDR whitelist docs (no transit gateway initial)
- upgrades: one-step patch upgrades with preflight checks and a manual rollback playbook
- auth: support for customer KMS keys (AWS/GCP) and token-based control plane auth
- testing: smoke tests + e2e on our CI infra targeting identical config

sophia: MVP criteria that must be met before GA:
- successful install and upgrade on 3 customer environments (one air-gapped)
- automated preflight checks catch >90% of common misconfigs
- upgrade/rollback runbook validated in staging
- documented perf baseline + known degradations for quantized models

maya: Customers will push for auto-upgrades. We should explicitly mark auto-upgrade as stretch — customers prefer manual approvals initially.

ian: Agree. Stretch scope could include:
- operator that supports in-place schema migrations and zero-downtime KV cache handoff
- transit gateway / multi-region private networking
- automated canary upgrades + rollback on error
- UI for upgrade management in the console (for private control plane)

alex: Technical risk: in-place KV cache handoff requires serialization format guarantees. Short-term we can do pivot strategy: create a compatible fallback model variant.

jules: Compliance must be in scope for enterprise beta: FIPS flag, HSM support, audit log retention policy (configurable). Otherwise we can't sign contracts for regulated sectors.

deploy-bot: CI job "private-deploy-smoke" has been added — runs helm install -> basic API checks -> upgrade test.

sophia: Prioritization ask: rank these by effort/impact. My suggestion:
1) MVP packaging + preflight checks (high impact, medium effort)
2) Customer KMS + audit logs (high impact, low-medium effort)
3) Upgrade playbook + manual rollback (high impact, low effort)
4) Airgap installer validation across 3 customers (high impact, medium-high effort)
5) Operator / zero-downtime upgrades (stretch, high effort)

ian: I’ll put effort estimates in the ticket. We also need a clear migration policy doc for existing hosted customers that want to move private.

maya: Sales input — call out pricing for Dedicated vs Private and support tiers. Enterprise buyers expect a defined onboarding SLA and runbook.

sophia: Action items:
- Ian: add effort estimates + open tickets for preflight checks and rollback playbook (owner: ian) — due EOD Tues
- Jules: draft security/hardening checklist + KMS/HSM integration notes — due Thu
- Maya: collect 3 candidate beta customers and confirm airgap environments — due Fri
- Alex: prototype KV compatibility check and fallback plan — due next Wed

ian: noted. Also flagging rollback automation as a separate epic if we want canary rollouts later.

sophia: Thanks all. I’ll synthesize into a roadmap doc and propose milestone dates in the product board. If anyone has objections to the MVP scope above, speak now or comment on the ticket. :white_check_mark:
